uploads.changelog:
v1.4
- New: XP bonuses in the bar – Cozy Sleeping Bag (+1 % per stack), Well Fed from food (+5 % kill XP) and the camp tent, each with time left.
- In the last minute the bonus glows orange and blinks, with a sound and a chat message – also when it has run out (can be turned off).
- New: dungeon & raid check – when you enter and on a ready check you see whether a flask/elixir and buff food are active and for how long.
- Choose what gets checked in /il (dungeon and raid separately). Check any time: /il check.
